hero.subtitle: A free live webinar on self-care for adoptive parents: real restoration, boundaries, and sustainable well-being.
hero.description:
Supporting children impacted by trauma, loss, foster care, and adoption can be deeply meaningful, but can also be emotionally exhausting. This webinar focuses on the importance of caregiver wellness, emotional regulation, boundaries, rest, and sustainable self-care practices.

Participants will explore the difference between true restoration and "faux self-care," while learning practical strategies to reduce burnout, increase resilience, and care for themselves without guilt. Caregivers will leave with tools to strengthen their own well-being so they can continue showing up with connection, patience, and compassion for their families.
